children.value: > Fact From Story two brilliant and sensible innings by KL Rahul and Virat Kohli, where they scored 97 runs off 115 balls and 85 runs off 116 balls, took India to shore
> Fact From Story India was in a terrible position at the start of the second innings as both of the openers got out for a duck, and India lost three wickets for just two runs.
> > Fact From Story Australia posted a target of 200 runs as they were bowled in 49.3 overs.
> > > Fact From Story David Warner scored 41 runs off 52 balls, and Steven Smith scored 46 runs off 71 balls in that innings.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge David Warner and Steven Smith are Australian players.
> > Fact From Story India won the match by six wickets.
> > > Fact From Story Ravindra Jadeja picked up three wickets, along with Kuldeep Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah picking up two each.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Taking wickets helps a team to win at cricket.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Getting wickets is required to win a cricket match.
> Commonsense Knowledge When a team scores more runs than the opposing team, they win.
